body:
## Pull request overview This pull request implements support for untagging nodes via re-authentication with empty RequestTags, addressing issue #2979. When a node re-authenticates via OIDC/web auth with `--advertise-tags= --force-reauth`, all tags are removed and ownership returns to the authenticating user. This allows nodes to transition from any tagged state (including nodes originally registered with a tagged pre-auth key) back to user-owned. **Changes:** - Added logic in HandleNodeFromAuthPath to process RequestTags during reauth, allowing empty/nil RequestTags to untag nodes and non-empty RequestTags to apply validated tags - Created comprehensive unit tests (TestWebAuthReauthWithEmptyTagsRemovesAllTags, TestAuthKeyTaggedToUserOwnedViaReauth) and integration tests (TestTagsUserLoginReauthWithEmptyTagsRemovesAllTags) to verify the untagging behavior - Minor code formatting improvements in util/dns.go (unrelated to main feature) ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | hscontrol/state/state.go | Core logic to handle RequestTags during reauth: empty tags untag the node and return ownership to user; non-empty tags are validated and applied | | hscontrol/auth_test.go | Unit tests for reauth untagging behavior covering both web-auth tagged nodes and authkey-tagged nodes | | integration/tags_test.go | Integration test verifying end-to-end reauth untagging workflow with --force-reauth flag | | hscontrol/util/dns.go | Minor formatting changes (blank lines, variable extraction) unrelated to the main feature | | .github/workflows/test-integration.yaml | Added new integration test to the test matrix |

message:
state: allow untagging nodes via reauth with empty RequestTags

When a node re-authenticates via OIDC/web auth with empty RequestTags
(from `tailscale up --advertise-tags= --force-reauth`), remove all tags
and return ownership to the authenticating user.

This allows nodes to transition from any tagged state (including nodes
originally registered with a tagged pre-auth key) back to user-owned.

Fixes #2979

integration: add test for reauth tag removal

Add TestTagsUserLoginReauthWithEmptyTagsRemovesAllTags to validate that
nodes can be untagged via `tailscale up --advertise-tags= --force-reauth`.

The test verifies:
- Node starts with tags and is owned by tagged-devices
- After reauth with empty tags, all tags are removed
- Node ownership returns to the authenticating user

Updates #2979
